verdict.rationale: Docusign offers configurable workflows, templates, and CLM automation, plus an MCP connector letting AI tools like Claude retrieve agreement data and trigger workflow actions (docusign-docs-11, docusign-docs-12, docusign-probe-3), which hints at agent-driven automation. However there is no evidence of scheduled/event-triggered background jobs that run fully autonomously without a human or agent initiating each call. Missing for 10: documented triggers/webhooks/schedulers for unattended background execution, evidence of persistent autonomous agents monitoring and acting on agreements without prompt, independent confirmation of the MCP connector enabling true background automation.
